thread.title: Lawrence: Trump failed to explain his war, disgraced military calling it 'a little journey to Iran'
thread.title_full: Lawrence: Trump failed to explain his war, disgraced military calling it 'a little journey to Iran'

author: @craigrussell7542
text: I've actually been waiting for Last Word to hear Lawrence's editorial, cause I just watched it here in Australia & honestly I'm still in disbelief As one of the other countries that he's disparaged, threatened, belittled, tried conning & depending on his mood either currently dumped or buddied up to, I'd like to say I'm not surprised at that speech....but unfortunately I am. I barely understood or was able to follow anything he said, then again after all these decades I still keep expecting sentences & these days that's a big ask Note to self: Stop thinking one day Trump will string a comprehensible sentence together. If he couldn't do it for King Charles he'll never do it for us. Anyhoo, at least you can rely on his decaying speech patterns & inability to ever say anything that isn't about himself, Obama or Biden & that's comforting isn't it....just as knowing if he's talking he's lying 😉😏😎🪃🦘
